description: A short brief for one wallet on Robinhood Chain, read only: each stock token it holds with value and 24h change, the portfolio total, and today’s top three movers you can buy. No key is needed for that. With a key for the same wallet, it adds what is left of today’s model allowance and the scheduled buys ready to sign, with their links; without one, it only counts the buys ready to sign and points to https://keyfo.xyz/app. It reads data on request; nothing is sent on a schedule.
name: portfolio_brief
title: Portfolio brief
